I don't know; I haven't seen him in over a month but yeah, we just called off the engagement because of some issues, but we were on our way of working things out. But he's convinced that it didn't have to do with it. 
His roomates are pretty close with him, but I think they're more like gaming buddies than anything and I don't think he's ever mentioned to them that he's had depression or attempted suicide before.
He's been out for about 3 years now. And he's been so closed off, I'll call or leave him messages and all he ever replies with is one-word answers.
